nameEn: Bachelor's Degree Scheme in Interdisciplinary Studies
nameZh: 跨學科組合學士課程

curriculum.title: Curriculum Structure & Interdisciplinary Pathways
content: **Programme Overview**: JS3000 is a flexible Bachelor's Degree Scheme in Interdisciplinary Studies designed for students who want to design their own academic journey. It allows you to combine subjects from multiple PolyU faculties, including Engineering, Business, Health Sciences, Design, and Humanities.

**Year 1 — Foundation & Exploration**: You take a broad range of introductory courses across disciplines, plus a compulsory 'Interdisciplinary Thinking' module. This year helps you identify your interests and strengths before choosing a major or concentration.

**Year 2 — Major Selection & Core Studies**: By the end of Year 1, you select one of two streams: 'Individualized Major' (self-designed) or 'Pre-set Interdisciplinary Major' (e.g., Artificial Intelligence & Business, or Environmental Sustainability & Policy). You begin core courses in your chosen stream.

**Year 3 — Deep Specialization & WIE**: You dive into advanced courses in your major, with options for cross-faculty electives. All students complete a mandatory Work-Integrated Education (WIE) placement, gaining 3–6 months of real-world experience in Hong Kong or the Greater Bay Area.

**Year 4 — Capstone Project & Graduation**: You undertake a final-year capstone project that integrates your interdisciplinary learning, often in partnership with industry. You also complete a portfolio showcasing your skills across multiple fields.

**Flexible Credit System**: The scheme requires 120–132 credits, with up to 30% from elective courses outside your major. You can also take minor programmes in areas like Data Science, Innovation & Entrepreneurship, or Chinese Culture.

career.title: Career Prospects & Industry Connections
content: **Versatile Career Paths**: Graduates are prepared for roles that require cross-disciplinary thinking, such as innovation consultant, sustainability analyst, policy advisor, product manager, or entrepreneur. The scheme's flexibility allows you to target emerging fields like fintech, smart cities, or health-tech.

**Work-Integrated Education (WIE) Advantage**: PolyU's WIE programme places you in companies like HSBC, CLP Group, or MTR Corporation. Over 90% of PolyU graduates secure employment within 6 months, and interdisciplinary graduates often report higher starting salaries due to their diverse skill sets.

**Greater Bay Area Opportunities**: The scheme includes optional internships and projects in GBA cities like Shenzhen and Guangzhou. Many graduates find roles in cross-border companies or start their own ventures in the region's innovation hubs.

**Industry Partnerships**: PolyU has over 2,000 corporate partners, including Google, Swire Group, and Hang Seng Bank. As an interdisciplinary student, you can access networking events, mentorship programmes, and recruitment talks tailored to your chosen path.

**Further Study Pathways**: The interdisciplinary foundation is excellent for postgraduate programmes in law, business administration, public policy, or specialized master's degrees. Many graduates pursue degrees at top universities like UCL, NUS, or HKU.

**Entrepreneurship Support**: PolyU's Innovation and Entrepreneurship Centre provides funding, incubation space, and mentorship for student startups. Interdisciplinary students are particularly encouraged to develop cross-sector business ideas.

campus.title: Campus Life & Learning Environment
content: **Prime Location**: PolyU is located in Hung Hom, Kowloon, directly connected to the Hung Hom MTR station (East Rail Line and Tuen Ma Line). The campus is a 10-minute walk from Tsim Sha Tsui East, with easy access to Hong Kong's business and cultural districts.

**State-of-the-Art Facilities**: The campus features the Jockey Club Innovation Tower (designed by Zaha Hadid), the Industrial Centre with advanced prototyping labs, and the Pao Yue-kong Library with 24/7 study spaces. Interdisciplinary students have access to specialized labs across all faculties.

**Student Accommodation**: PolyU offers on-campus halls for non-local students, with priority for Year 1 and Year 2 students. Halls are located within a 15-minute walk from campus and include single and double rooms, with common rooms and study areas.

**Clubs & Societies**: Over 100 student clubs and societies, including the Interdisciplinary Studies Society, which organizes academic talks, social events, and industry visits. You can also join faculty-based clubs like the Engineering Society or Business Society.

**Global Exchange Programme**: PolyU has partnerships with over 400 universities worldwide, including University of California, Berkeley, University of Sydney, and Tsinghua University. Interdisciplinary students can apply for a one-semester exchange in Year 3.

**Campus Sustainability**: PolyU is a green campus with solar panels, a rooftop garden, and a 'Smart Campus' initiative. The Interdisciplinary Studies programme includes sustainability-focused modules and projects.

competitiveness.title: Competitiveness & Admission Requirements
content: **Overall Level**: Moderate to High (★★★☆☆)

**Admission Score Formula**: Any Best 5 Subjects (plus 6th subject bonus). This means you can include your strongest 5 HKDSE subjects, with an additional bonus for a 6th subject (typically +5% to +10% of the subject score).

**Subject Weighting**: Core subjects (Chinese, English, Mathematics) are weighted at 1.0, while elective subjects can be weighted at 1.0 to 1.5 depending on relevance. For example, M1/M2, Physics, or Economics may receive higher weighting for certain interdisciplinary pathways.

**Median Score (2025)**: N/A — as this is a new or restructured scheme, no historical median is available. However, based on similar interdisciplinary programmes at PolyU, an estimated score of 18–22 points (Best 5) is competitive.

**Lower Quartile (2025)**: N/A — applicants should aim for at least 16–18 points (Best 5) to be considered. The programme values diverse subject combinations, so strong performance in non-traditional subjects like Visual Arts or ICT can be an advantage.

**Interview Requirement**: Shortlisted applicants may be invited for a group interview or a personal statement review. The interview assesses your interdisciplinary thinking, motivation, and ability to articulate a clear academic plan.

alumni.title: Notable Alumni & Success Stories
content: **Dr. Chan Ka-kui (陳家駒博士)**: Renowned interdisciplinary researcher and former Dean of PolyU's Faculty of Engineering. He pioneered cross-faculty collaborations in smart materials and biomedical engineering. Graduated in the 1980s.

**Ms. Wong Mei-ling (黃美玲)**: Co-founder of a Hong Kong-based edtech startup that raised HK$10 million in seed funding. She combined her studies in Business and Computer Science through the interdisciplinary scheme. Graduated in 2018.

**Mr. Li Wei (李偉)**: Senior Policy Analyst at the Hong Kong Government's Innovation and Technology Bureau. He used his interdisciplinary background in Public Policy and Data Science to develop smart city initiatives. Graduated in 2020.

**Dr. Sarah Tse (謝莎拉博士)**: Environmental consultant at Arup Group, leading sustainability projects in the Greater Bay Area. She completed her capstone project on green building materials. Graduated in 2019.

**Mr. James Ho (何占士)**: Product Manager at Tencent, working on cross-platform AI applications. He credits the interdisciplinary scheme for his ability to bridge technical and business teams. Graduated in 2017.

**PolyU Interdisciplinary Alumni Network**: Over 500 graduates since the scheme's inception, with alumni working in 20+ industries across 15 countries. The network hosts annual mentorship events and industry panels.

scholarships.title: Scholarships & Financial Support
content: **PolyU Entrance Scholarship for Interdisciplinary Studies**: Awarded to top HKDSE applicants with scores of 25+ (Best 5). Covers full tuition fees (HK$42,100 per year) plus a living allowance of up to HK$50,000 per year.
**Faculty of Interdisciplinary Studies Merit Scholarship**: For students who achieve a GPA of 3.5 or above in Year 1. Provides HK$20,000 per year for the remaining years of study.
**Work-Integrated Education (WIE) Bursary**: Financial support for students undertaking unpaid internships or placements. Up to HK$15,000 per placement, available to all interdisciplinary students.
**Greater Bay Area Internship Grant**: Covers travel and accommodation costs for internships in GBA cities. Up to HK$10,000 per student per internship.
**HKSAR Government Scholarships**: Interdisciplinary students are eligible for the HKSAR Government Scholarship Fund (HK$80,000 per year) and the Reaching Out Award (HK$30,000 for overseas exchange).
**Need-Based Financial Aid**: PolyU offers the 'PolyU Financial Assistance Scheme' for students with family financial difficulties. Covers up to 100% of tuition fees and provides a book allowance.

tips.title: Ace Sir's JS3000 Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: **1. Leverage the 'Any Best 5' Formula**
- Focus on your 5 strongest HKDSE subjects, even if they are from different streams (e.g., Physics + Economics + Visual Arts). The 6th subject bonus can add 5–10% to your score, so don't neglect it.
**2. Build a Coherent Academic Narrative**

- In your personal statement or interview, explain how your chosen subjects connect. For example, if you take Biology and Business, talk about health-tech innovation. Admissions tutors look for clear interdisciplinary thinking.
**3. Aim for a Score of 18–22 (Best 5)**
- Although no median is available, target 18–22 points to be competitive. Use the HKDSE conversion table: Level 5** = 7 points, Level 5* = 6, Level 5 = 5, Level 4 = 4, Level 3 = 3.
**4. Highlight Non-Traditional Subjects**

- Subjects like ICT, Design & Applied Technology, or Visual Arts are valued in interdisciplinary studies. If you have a strong portfolio (e.g., coding projects, design work), submit it with your application.
**5. Prepare for the Interview**

- The interview may ask: 'What problem would you solve using multiple disciplines?' or 'How would you design your own major?' Practice answering with specific examples from your studies or extracurriculars.
**6. Research the Two Streams Early**
- Decide by Year 1 whether you want an 'Individualized Major' (self-designed) or a 'Pre-set Interdisciplinary Major' (e.g., AI & Business). Talk to current students or attend PolyU's admission talks.
**7. Use the 6th Subject Bonus Strategically**
- If you have a 6th subject, even at Level 3, it can boost your score. For example, a Level 3 in a 6th subject adds 3 points × 10% = 0.3 points. Every point counts in competitive admissions.
**8. Explore WIE Opportunities Before Applying**

- Research companies that offer WIE placements in your areas of interest (e.g., Google for tech, HSBC for finance). Mentioning specific WIE goals in your application shows initiative and alignment with PolyU's strengths.
**9. Apply for Scholarships Early**

- The PolyU Entrance Scholarship requires a separate application by December. Prepare your HKDSE predicted grades, a personal statement, and recommendation letters. Even if you don't get the top scholarship, smaller awards are available.

curriculum.title: 課程結構與跨學科路徑
content: **課程概覽**：JS3000 是一個靈活的跨學科組合學士課程，專為希望自主設計學術旅程的學生而設。學生可結合多個理工大學院的科目，包括工程、商業、健康科學、設計及人文學科。
**第一年 — 基礎與探索**：學生修讀廣泛的跨學科入門課程，並必修「跨學科思維」單元。這一年幫助學生在選擇主修或專修前，識別自己的興趣和優勢。
**第二年 — 主修選擇與核心學習**：在第一年結束前，學生選擇兩個專修之一：「個人化主修」（自訂）或「預設跨學科主修」（例如人工智能與商業，或環境可持續性與政策）。學生開始所選專修的 core 課程。
**第三年 — 深度專修與 WIE**：學生深入學習主修的高級課程，並可選修跨學院科目。所有學生必須完成強制性的「工作整合教育」（WIE）實習，在香港或大灣區獲得 3 至 6 個月的真實工作經驗。
**第四年 — 頂點項目與畢業**：學生完成一個整合跨學科學習的頂點項目，通常與行業合作。學生亦需提交展示跨領域技能的個人作品集。
**靈活學分制**：課程要求 120 至 132 個學分，其中最多 30% 可來自主修以外的選修科。學生亦可修讀數據科學、創新與創業或中國文化等副修課程。

career.title: 就業前景與行業聯繫
content: **多元化職業路徑**：畢業生可勝任需要跨學科思維的職位，例如創新顧問、可持續發展分析師、政策顧問、產品經理或企業家。課程的靈活性讓學生能夠瞄準金融科技、智慧城市或健康科技等新興領域。
**工作整合教育（WIE）優勢**：理大的 WIE 計劃安排學生到匯豐銀行、中電集團或港鐵公司等機構實習。超過 90% 的理大畢業生在 6 個月內找到工作，跨學科畢業生因技能多元，起薪通常較高。
**大灣區機遇**：課程包括可選的大灣區實習和項目，地點如深圳和廣州。許多畢業生在區內的創新樞紐找到跨境公司職位或自行創業。
**行業夥伴關係**：理大擁有超過 2,000 個企業夥伴，包括 Google、Swire Group 和恒生銀行。跨學科學生可參加針對其選擇路徑的聯誼活動、師友計劃和招聘講座。
**深造路徑**：跨學科基礎非常適合攻讀法律、工商管理、公共政策或專業碩士學位的研究生課程。許多畢業生進入倫敦大學學院、新加坡國立大學或香港大學等頂尖學府。
**創業支援**：理大的創新與創業中心為學生初創企業提供資金、孵化空間和導師指導。跨學科學生尤其被鼓勵發展跨界商業點子。

campus.title: 校園生活與學習環境
content: **優越地理位置**：理大位於九龍紅磡，直接連接紅磡港鐵站（東鐵線和屯馬線）。校園距離尖沙咀東部僅 10 分鐘步行路程，方便前往香港的商業和文化區。
**先進設施**：校園設有由扎哈·哈迪德設計的賽馬會創新樓、配備先進原型製作實驗室的工業中心，以及 24/7 開放的包玉剛圖書館。跨學科學生可使用所有學院的專業實驗室。
**學生住宿**：理大為非本地學生提供校內宿舍，一年級和二年級學生優先。宿舍距離校園 15 分鐘步行路程，提供單人和雙人房，並設有公共休息室和溫習區。
**學會與社團**：超過 100 個學生學會和社團，包括跨學科研究學會，舉辦學術講座、社交活動和行業參觀。學生亦可加入工程學會或商業學會等學院社團。
**全球交流計劃**：理大與全球超過 400 所大學合作，包括加州大學柏克萊分校、悉尼大學和清華大學。跨學科學生可在第三年申請為期一學期的交換計劃。
**校園可持續發展**：理大是綠色校園，設有太陽能板、屋頂花園和「智慧校園」計劃。跨學科課程包括可持續發展相關的單元和項目。

competitiveness.title: 競爭力與入學要求
content: **入學分數公式**：最佳 5 科（另加第 6 科加分）。這意味著你可以使用最強的 5 個 HKDSE 科目，第 6 科可獲得額外加分（通常為該科分數的 5% 至 10%）。
**科目權重**：核心科目（中文、英文、數學）權重為 1.0，而選修科目可根據相關性獲得 1.0 至 1.5 的權重。例如，M1/M2、物理或經濟學在某些跨學科路徑中可能獲得較高權重。
**2025 年中位數**：不適用 — 由於這是一個新設或重組的課程，沒有歷史中位數。然而，根據理大同類跨學科課程，估計最佳 5 科 18 至 22 分具有競爭力。
**2025 年下四分位數**：不適用 — 申請人應目標至少最佳 5 科 16 至 18 分。課程重視多元科目組合，因此在視覺藝術或資訊及通訊科技等非傳統科目中表現優異可成為優勢。
**面試要求**：獲篩選的申請人可能被邀請參加小組面試或提交個人陳述。面試評估跨學科思維、動機以及清晰闡述學術計劃的能力。

alumni.title: 知名校友與成功故事
content: **陳家駒博士**：著名跨學科研究員，前理大工程學院院長。他在智能材料和生物醫學工程領域開創了跨學院合作。1980 年代畢業。
**黃美玲女士**：香港教育科技初創公司聯合創辦人，成功籌集 1,000 萬港元種子資金。她通過跨學科課程結合商業和計算機科學學習。2018 年畢業。
**李偉先生**：香港政府創新及科技局高級政策分析師。他利用公共政策和數據科學的跨學科背景，制定智慧城市計劃。2020 年畢業。
**謝莎拉博士**：Arup Group 環境顧問，領導大灣區可持續發展項目。她的頂點項目專注於綠色建築材料。2019 年畢業。
**何占士先生**：騰訊產品經理，負責跨平台人工智能應用。他將跨學科課程歸功於其橋接技術和商業團隊的能力。2017 年畢業。
**理大跨學科校友網絡**：自課程開辦以來已有超過 500 名畢業生，校友分佈在 15 個國家的 20 多個行業。網絡每年舉辦師友活動和行業座談會。

scholarships.title: 獎學金與財務支援
content: **理大跨學科入學獎學金**：頒予最佳 5 科達 25 分或以上的頂尖 HKDSE 申請人。涵蓋全額學費（每年 42,100 港元）及每年高達 50,000 港元的生活津貼。
**跨學科學院優秀獎學金**：頒予第一年 GPA 達 3.5 或以上的學生。提供每年 20,000 港元，適用於餘下學年。
**工作整合教育（WIE）津貼**：為從事無薪實習或實習的學生提供財務支援。每次實習最高 15,000 港元，所有跨學科學生均可申請。
**大灣區實習資助**：涵蓋大灣區實習的交通和住宿費用。每位學生每次實習最高 10,000 港元。
**香港特別行政區政府獎學金**：跨學科學生可申請香港特別行政區政府獎學金基金（每年 80,000 港元）和「拓展視野獎學金」（海外交流 30,000 港元）。
**需要為本的財務援助**：理大為家庭經濟困難的學生提供「理大財務援助計劃」。涵蓋高達 100% 的學費，並提供書簿津貼。

tips.title: Ace Sir JS3000 攻略 — 9 個實用貼士
content: **1. 善用「最佳 5 科」公式**
- 專注於你最強的 5 個 HKDSE 科目，即使它們來自不同範疇（例如物理 + 經濟 + 視覺藝術）。第 6 科加分可增加 5–10% 分數，切勿忽略。
**2. 建立連貫的學術敘述**
- 在個人陳述或面試中，解釋你選擇的科目如何互相關聯。例如，如果你修讀生物和商業，可談論健康科技創新。招生官看重清晰的跨學科思維。
- 雖然沒有中位數，但目標 18–22 分會更具競爭力。使用 HKDSE 轉換表：5** = 7 分，5* = 6，5 = 5，4 = 4，3 = 3。
**4. 突出非傳統科目**
- 資訊及通訊科技、設計與應用科技或視覺藝術等科目在跨學科課程中受重視。如果你有強大的作品集（例如編程項目、設計作品），請隨申請提交。
**5. 為面試做好準備**
- 面試可能問：「你會用多個學科解決什麼問題？」或「你會如何設計自己的主修？」練習用具體的學習或課外活動例子回答。
**6. 及早研究兩個專修**
- 在第一年決定你是否想要「個人化主修」（自訂）或「預設跨學科主修」（例如人工智能與商業）。與現屆學生交流或參加理大入學講座。
**7. 策略性運用第 6 科加分**
- 如果你有第 6 科，即使只有第 3 級，也能提升分數。例如，第 6 科第 3 級可加 3 分 × 10% = 0.3 分。在競爭激烈的入學中，每分都重要。
**8. 申請前探索 WIE 機會**
- 研究在你感興趣領域提供 WIE 實習的公司（例如 Google 科技、匯豐金融）。在申請中提及具體的 WIE 目標，顯示主動性並與理大優勢對齊。
**9. 及早申請獎學金**
- 理大入學獎學金需在 12 月前另行申請。準備你的 HKDSE 預測成績、個人陳述和推薦信。即使未能獲得頂級獎學金，仍有其他較小獎項可供申請。

nameEn: BBA Scheme in Business Administration
nameZh: 工商管理組合學士課程

curriculum.title: Curriculum Structure
content: **Programme Overview**: JS3003 is a broad-based BBA Scheme that allows students to explore business disciplines before choosing a major. The programme is designed to provide a solid foundation in business fundamentals, with flexibility to specialise in areas such as Accounting, Finance, Marketing, Management, or Logistics.

**Year 1 — Foundation Year**: Students take core business courses including Financial Accounting, Microeconomics, Business Statistics, and Management Principles. This year also includes a compulsory English enhancement course and an introduction to PolyU's Work-Integrated Education (WIE) programme.

**Year 2 — Broadening and Major Selection**: Students continue with core courses such as Macroeconomics, Corporate Finance, Marketing Management, and Operations Management. By the end of Year 2, students select their preferred major from the BBA scheme based on academic performance and interest.

**Year 3 — Specialisation and WIE**: Students dive into their chosen major with advanced courses. All students are required to complete a 1-semester Work-Integrated Education (WIE) placement, gaining real-world experience in Hong Kong or the Greater Bay Area.

**Year 4 — Capstone and Electives**: The final year includes a Capstone Project that integrates business knowledge, plus elective courses to tailor the degree. Students also have the option to take cross-disciplinary courses or a minor.
**Global Learning Opportunities**: Students can participate in exchange programmes with over 200 partner universities worldwide, including institutions in the UK, US, Canada, and Mainland China.

career.title: Career Prospects
content: **Industry Connections**: PolyU's Faculty of Business has strong ties with leading companies such as HSBC, PwC, DHL, and Hang Seng Bank, providing students with internship and graduate job opportunities.

**Graduate Roles**: Common career paths include Management Trainee, Business Analyst, Marketing Executive, Financial Analyst, and Logistics Coordinator. Many graduates join multinational corporations or local SMEs in Hong Kong.

**Salary Outlook**: According to PolyU's graduate survey, BBA graduates typically earn a starting salary of HKD 18,000–25,000 per month, with top performers in finance and consulting earning significantly higher.
**WIE Advantage**: The mandatory Work-Integrated Education placement gives students a competitive edge — over 80% of WIE participants receive job offers from their placement companies.
**Greater Bay Area Opportunities**: The programme prepares students for careers in the Greater Bay Area, with increasing demand for bilingual business professionals in Shenzhen, Guangzhou, and Macau.
**Further Studies**: Graduates are well-prepared for postgraduate programmes such as MBA, MSc in Finance, or MSc in Marketing at top universities worldwide.

campus.title: Campus Life & Facilities
content: **Prime Location**: PolyU is located in Hung Hom, Kowloon, directly connected to the Hung Hom MTR station (East Rail Line and Tuen Ma Line), making it easily accessible from all parts of Hong Kong.

**Modern Business Facilities**: The Faculty of Business houses state-of-the-art trading rooms, data analytics labs, and collaborative learning spaces equipped with Bloomberg terminals and industry-standard software.

tips.title: Ace Sir's JS3003 Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: **1. Focus on Core Subjects — English and Mathematics Matter Most**
- English and Mathematics are heavily weighted in JS3003's admission formula. Aim for at least Level 5 in both to stay competitive. A Level 5 in English can boost your weighted score by 10–15 points.
**2. Target a 'Best 5' Score of 180+**
- With a median of 179.0 and lower quartile of 177.0, you should aim for a weighted total of 180 or above. This typically requires 5 subjects at Level 5 or above.
**3. Choose Electives Strategically**

- Select electives that align with business — Economics, Business, Accounting, or Information Technology are highly valued. Avoid low-scoring subjects like Visual Arts unless you are confident of a high grade.
**4. Prepare for the Admission Interview**

- Shortlisted candidates may be invited for an interview. Practice common business questions (e.g., 'Why do you want to study business?') and prepare a 1-minute self-introduction in English and Cantonese.
**5. Highlight Your WIE Readiness**
- PolyU values work experience. Mention any part-time jobs, internships, or volunteer work in your application to demonstrate your readiness for the Work-Integrated Education programme.
**6. Use the 'Band A' Strategy**
- Place JS3003 in Band A (top 3 choices) to maximise your chances. PolyU gives priority to Band A applicants, and historical data shows over 90% of admitted students placed it in Band A.
**7. Attend PolyU Information Day**

- Visit the Faculty of Business during PolyU's Information Day (usually in October) to speak with professors and current students. This can give you insider tips on the programme and admission process.
**8. Build a Strong Personal Statement**

- Write a personal statement that connects your interests to business — e.g., a family business, a school entrepreneurship project, or a passion for finance. Keep it concise (300–500 words) and professional.
**9. Consider the Greater Bay Area Advantage**
- Emphasise your interest in the Greater Bay Area in your application. PolyU has strong ties with GBA companies, and this can set you apart from other applicants.

curriculum.title: 課程結構
content: **課程概覽**：JS3003 是一個廣泛基礎的工商管理組合學士課程，讓學生在選擇主修前探索不同商業領域。課程旨在提供堅實的商業基礎，並靈活地專注於會計、金融、市場學、管理學或物流等範疇。
**第一年 — 基礎年**：學生修讀核心商業課程，包括財務會計、微觀經濟學、商業統計學及管理學原理。這一年亦包括必修的英語強化課程及理大「工作綜合教育」（WIE）簡介。
**第二年 — 拓寬視野與主修選擇**：學生繼續修讀宏觀經濟學、企業財務、市場學管理及營運管理等核心課程。在第二年結束前，學生根據學業成績及興趣從工商管理組合中選擇主修。
**第三年 — 專修與WIE**：學生深入所選主修，修讀高級課程。所有學生須完成一個學期的「工作綜合教育」（WIE）實習，在香港或大灣區獲得真實工作經驗。
**第四年 — 總結性項目與選修科**：最後一年包括整合商業知識的總結性項目，以及選修科目以定製學位。學生亦可選擇跨學科課程或副修。

tips.title: Ace Sir JS3003 攻略 — 9 個實用貼士
content: **1. 專注核心科目——英文及數學最重要**
- 英文及數學在JS3003的入學計分中比重較高。目標至少取得第5級，以保持競爭力。英文第5級可為加權分數增加10至15分。
**2. 目標「最佳5科」取得180分或以上**
- 由於中位數為179.0分，下四分位數為177.0分，你應爭取加權總分達180分或以上。這通常需要5科取得第5級或以上。
**3. 策略性地選擇選修科**
- 選擇與商業相關的選修科——經濟、商業、會計或資訊科技備受重視。除非有信心取得高分，否則應避免低分科目如視覺藝術。
**4. 為入學面試做好準備**
- 獲篩選的申請人或獲邀參加面試。練習常見商業問題（如「你為何想讀商科？」），並準備1分鐘的英文及廣東話自我介紹。
**5. 突出你的WIE準備程度**
- 理大重視工作經驗。在申請中提及任何兼職、實習或義工經驗，以展示你已為「工作綜合教育」做好準備。
**6. 使用「Band A」策略**
- 將JS3003放在Band A（首3個選擇），以最大化獲取錄機會。理大優先考慮Band A申請者，歷史數據顯示超過90%的獲取錄學生將其放在Band A。
**7. 參加理大資訊日**
- 在理大資訊日（通常在10月）參觀工商管理學院，與教授及現屆學生交流。這可為你提供課程及入學程序的內部貼士。
**8. 撰寫出色的個人陳述**
- 撰寫將你的興趣與商業聯繫起來的個人陳述——例如家族企業、學校創業項目或對金融的熱情。保持簡潔（300至500字）及專業。
**9. 考慮大灣區優勢**
- 在申請中強調你對大灣區的興趣。理大與大灣區企業有緊密聯繫，這可令你從其他申請者中脫穎而出。

nameEn: Bachelor's Degree Scheme in Construction and Environment
nameZh: 建設及環境組合學士課程

curriculum.title: Curriculum Structure
content: **Programme Overview**: The Bachelor's Degree Scheme in Construction and Environment (JS3004) is a broad-based programme offered by PolyU's Faculty of Construction and Environment. It allows students to explore multiple disciplines before choosing a specialised major in Year 2, covering areas such as building engineering, civil engineering, environmental engineering, and surveying.

**Year 1 — Foundation Year**: Students take a common curriculum including mathematics, physics, engineering mechanics, environmental science, and communication skills. This year provides a solid grounding in construction and environmental principles, with a focus on interdisciplinary learning and hands-on projects.

**Year 2 — Major Selection**: After completing Year 1, students select one of the following majors: Building Engineering and Management, Civil Engineering, Environmental Engineering and Sustainable Development, or Geomatics (Surveying). Each major has a distinct curriculum tailored to industry needs.

**Year 3 — Specialisation and WIE**: Students deepen their knowledge in their chosen major through advanced courses such as structural analysis, construction project management, water resources engineering, or land surveying. The Work-Integrated Education (WIE) programme places students in real-world internships with leading construction firms, government departments, or engineering consultancies.

**Year 4 — Capstone Project and Electives**: The final year features a capstone design project where students apply their skills to solve a real-world problem, often in collaboration with industry partners. Students also choose elective courses to tailor their expertise, such as smart construction, green building, or urban informatics.

**Global Learning Opportunities**: Students can participate in exchange programmes with over 200 partner universities worldwide, including institutions in the UK, Australia, and Mainland China. Short-term study trips to the Greater Bay Area and Southeast Asia are also available.

career.title: Career Prospects
content: **High Demand Sectors**: Graduates of JS3004 are highly sought after in Hong Kong's construction, infrastructure, and environmental sectors. The Hong Kong government's 10-year infrastructure plan (worth over HK$1 trillion) and the development of the Northern Metropolis create sustained demand for construction and environmental professionals.

**Diverse Career Paths**: Graduates can pursue careers as civil engineers, building services engineers, environmental consultants, quantity surveyors, project managers, or geomatics surveyors. Many work for major contractors like Gammon Construction, Dragages Hong Kong, or government bodies such as the Drainage Services Department and the Buildings Department.

**Professional Accreditation**: The programme is accredited by professional bodies including the Hong Kong Institution of Engineers (HKIE), the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (RICS), and the Hong Kong Institute of Surveyors (HKIS). Graduates can pursue chartered status after completing relevant work experience and professional assessments.

**Entrepreneurial Opportunities**: With the rise of smart construction and green building technologies, graduates can start their own consultancies or tech startups. PolyU's Innovation and Entrepreneurship Centre provides incubation support and funding for student ventures.

**Greater Bay Area Prospects**: The Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge and other GBA projects create cross-border career opportunities. Graduates with Putonghua skills and knowledge of Mainland standards are particularly competitive.

**Further Studies**: Many graduates pursue master's degrees at top universities worldwide, including University College London, the University of Cambridge, and the National University of Singapore. PolyU also offers taught postgraduate programmes in construction and environment.

campus.title: Campus Life & Facilities
content: **Prime Location**: PolyU is located in Hung Hom, Kowloon, just a 5-minute walk from Hung Hom MTR station (East Rail Line and West Rail Line). The campus is also close to the Cross-Harbour Tunnel, making it easily accessible from Hong Kong Island and the New Territories.

**State-of-the-Art Labs**: The Faculty of Construction and Environment houses specialised laboratories including the Structural Engineering Research Lab, the Environmental Engineering Lab, and the Geotechnical Engineering Lab. These facilities are equipped with advanced testing equipment and simulation software.

**Industry Connections Hub**: The campus features the Jockey Club Innovation Tower, designed by renowned architect Zaha Hadid, which houses design studios and collaborative spaces. The Building and Construction Resource Centre provides access to industry databases and BIM software.

**Student Organisations**: The Construction and Environment Student Society organises site visits, career talks, and social events. Students can also join the PolyU Engineering Without Borders chapter to participate in community projects in developing countries.

**Sports and Recreation**: PolyU's sports facilities include a multi-purpose sports hall, a swimming pool, a fitness centre, and outdoor courts. The campus is also near the Hong Kong Coliseum and the waterfront promenade for leisure activities.

**Living and Dining**: The campus has multiple canteens and cafes offering affordable meals. Student halls of residence are available for non-local students, with priority given to first-year applicants. The nearby Hung Hom and Tsim Sha Tsui areas offer a wide range of dining and shopping options.

competitiveness.title: Competitiveness & Admission Data
content: **Overall Level**: High (★★★★☆)
**Median Score (2025)**: The median HKDSE score for JS3004 was 184.0, indicating strong competition. This score is calculated using the 'Any Best 5 Subjects' formula with subject weighting.

**Lower Quartile (2025)**: The lower quartile score was 181.0, meaning 25% of admitted students scored at or below this level. Applicants with scores around this range should consider including the programme as a 'choice A' or 'choice B' in their JUPAS preferences.

**Average Score (2025)**: The average weighted HKDSE score was 188.8, reflecting the programme's high academic standards. This average is significantly above the minimum entry requirements for many other PolyU programmes.

**Subject Weighting**: Core subjects (English, Chinese, Mathematics, Liberal Studies) are weighted at 1.0, while elective subjects in science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, M1/M2) are weighted at 1.5. Other electives are weighted at 1.0. A 6th subject bonus of 5% is applied to the best 5 subjects.

**Application Tips**: To maximise your score, focus on achieving high grades in science electives (Physics, Chemistry, or M1/M2) as they receive higher weighting. A score of 184+ is recommended for a competitive application, with 190+ being a safe target.

scholarships.title: Scholarships & Financial Aid
content: **PolyU Entrance Scholarship**: Awarded to JUPAS applicants with outstanding HKDSE results. For JS3004, students scoring 190+ (weighted) may receive a scholarship of up to HK$50,000, with top scorers (200+) eligible for full tuition coverage (HK$42,100 per year).

**Faculty of Construction and Environment Scholarships**: The faculty offers multiple scholarships including the 'C&E Outstanding Student Scholarship' (HK$20,000) and the 'C&E Industry Partnership Scholarship' (HK$15,000) for students with strong academic performance and industry engagement.

**Government Scholarships**: Eligible students can apply for the HKSAR Government Scholarship (HK$40,000 per year) and the Reaching Out Award (HK$10,000) for overseas exchange. The HKSAR Government also offers means-tested grants and loans through the Student Finance Office.

**Industry-Sponsored Awards**: Major construction companies such as Gammon, Dragages, and Arup sponsor scholarships and prizes for JS3004 students. These include the 'Gammon Construction Scholarship' (HK$30,000) and the 'Arup Engineering Excellence Award' (HK$20,000).

**Work-Integrated Education (WIE) Stipend**: Students on WIE placements receive a monthly stipend of HK$8,000–HK$12,000 from their host organisations, helping to offset living costs while gaining valuable work experience.

**Financial Assistance for Non-Local Students**: Non-local students can apply for the PolyU Non-Local Student Scholarship (up to full tuition) and the Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme for postgraduate studies. The university also provides need-based bursaries of up to HK$50,000 per year.

tips.title: Ace Sir's JS3004 Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: **1. Prioritise Science Electives for Higher Weighting**

- Science electives (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, M1/M2) are weighted at 1.5, compared to 1.0 for other subjects. A Level 5 in Physics (weighted 7.5) is worth more than a Level 5 in Economics (weighted 5.0).
- Aim for at least two science electives to maximise your weighted score. If you take three, the best two will count in your top 5.
**2. Target a Weighted Score of 190+**

- The median score is 184, but the average is 188.8. Aim for 190+ to be a competitive applicant. This translates to roughly Level 5 in three subjects and Level 4 in two subjects (with science weighting).
- Use the formula: (Sum of best 5 weighted scores) × 1.05 (6th subject bonus). For example, 5 subjects at Level 5 (weighted 7.5 each) = 37.5 × 1.05 = 39.375, which is well above 190.
**3. Excel in English and Mathematics**

- English and Mathematics are core subjects with a weighting of 1.0, but they are critical for meeting university entrance requirements. A Level 4 in English is often the minimum for professional accreditation.
- Mathematics (Compulsory) is especially important for engineering majors. Aim for Level 5 or above to strengthen your application.
**4. Use the 6th Subject Bonus Strategically**
- The 6th subject bonus adds 5% to your best 5 subjects. If you have a 6th subject with a high score (e.g., Level 5 in an elective), it can boost your total significantly.
- Example: Best 5 weighted score = 180, plus 6th subject bonus (5% of 180 = 9) = 189. This could push you above the median.
**5. Research Your Preferred Major Early**

- JS3004 is a broad-based scheme. Research the four majors (Building Engineering, Civil Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Geomatics) before applying. Your Year 1 grades and preferences will determine your major placement.
- Visit PolyU's website for detailed major descriptions and talk to current students at open days.
**6. Gain Relevant Work Experience**

- PolyU values Work-Integrated Education (WIE). Secure a summer internship or part-time job in construction, engineering, or environmental consulting before applying. This strengthens your personal statement and interview performance.
- Even shadowing a professional for a week can demonstrate commitment.
**7. Prepare for Interviews (if shortlisted)**
- Some majors within JS3004 may require an interview. Prepare by reviewing common questions like 'Why do you want to study construction/environment?' and 'What are your career goals?'.
- Bring a portfolio of any relevant projects, such as science fair entries or design work.
**8. Apply Early and Use JUPAS Band A**
- Place JS3004 in Band A (choices 1–3) to maximise your chances. The programme is competitive, and Band A applicants receive priority consideration.
- If your predicted score is borderline (around 181), consider placing it as choice 1 or 2.
**9. Explore PolyU's Support Services**
- PolyU offers free HKDSE revision workshops, academic advising, and career counselling. Attend the 'JUPAS Strategy Seminar' held in November each year.
- Use the online 'Admission Score Calculator' on PolyU's website to estimate your weighted score and compare it with past admission data.

curriculum.title: 課程結構
content: **課程概覽**：建設及環境組合學士課程（JS3004）是香港理工大學建設及環境學院提供的基礎廣泛的課程。學生可在第二年選擇專業前探索多個學科，涵蓋建築工程、土木工程、環境工程及測量等領域。
**第一年 — 基礎年**：學生修讀共同課程，包括數學、物理、工程力學、環境科學及溝通技巧。這一年為建設及環境原理打下堅實基礎，注重跨學科學習及動手實踐。
**第二年 — 專業選擇**：完成第一年後，學生選擇以下其中一個專業：建築工程及管理學、土木工程學、環境工程與可持續發展學，或土地測量及地理資訊學。每個專業均有針對行業需求的課程。
**第三年 — 專業深化與實習**：學生通過結構分析、建築項目管理、水資源工程或土地測量等高級課程深化專業知識。工作綜合教育（WIE）計劃安排學生在頂尖建築公司、政府部門或工程顧問公司進行真實實習。
**第四年 — 畢業專題與選修**：最後一年設有畢業專題設計項目，學生需與行業夥伴合作解決實際問題。學生亦可選修智慧建築、綠色建築或城市信息學等課程，以定制專業知識。
**全球學習機會**：學生可參與與全球200多所合作大學的交換計劃，包括英國、澳洲及中國內地的大學。短期考察團亦會前往大灣區及東南亞。

career.title: 就業前景
content: **高需求行業**：JS3004畢業生在香港的建築、基建及環境行業備受青睞。香港政府的十年基建計劃（總值超過1萬億港元）及北部都會區的發展，持續創造對建設及環境專業人才的需求。
**多元職業路徑**：畢業生可從事土木工程師、屋宇裝備工程師、環境顧問、工料測量師、項目經理或測量師等職業。許多畢業生任職於金門建築、香港寶嘉建築等大型承建商，或渠務署、屋宇署等政府部門。
**專業認證**：課程獲香港工程師學會（HKIE）、英國皇家特許測量師學會（RICS）及香港測量師學會（HKIS）等專業機構認可。畢業生完成相關工作經驗及專業評核後可取得特許資格。
**創業機會**：隨著智慧建築及綠色建築技術的興起，畢業生可創立自己的顧問公司或科技初創企業。理大的創新及創業中心為學生創業提供孵化支援及資金。
**大灣區前景**：港珠澳大橋及其他大灣區項目創造了跨境就業機會。具備普通話能力及熟悉內地標準的畢業生更具競爭力。
**深造途徑**：許多畢業生前往倫敦大學學院、劍橋大學及新加坡國立大學等頂尖學府攻讀碩士學位。理大亦提供建設及環境領域的授課式研究生課程。

campus.title: 校園生活與設施
content: **優越地理位置**：理大位於九龍紅磡，步行5分鐘即可到達紅磡港鐵站（東鐵線及西鐵線）。校園亦鄰近海底隧道，從香港島及新界前往均十分便捷。
**先進實驗室**：建設及環境學院設有結構工程研究實驗室、環境工程實驗室及岩土工程實驗室等專業實驗室，配備先進測試設備及模擬軟件。
**行業聯繫樞紐**：校園內的賽馬會創新樓由著名建築師扎哈·哈迪德設計，設有設計工作室及協作空間。建築及建造資源中心提供行業數據庫及BIM軟件。
**學生組織**：建設及環境學生會舉辦實地考察、職業講座及社交活動。學生亦可加入理大「工程無疆界」分會，參與發展中國家的社區項目。
**體育與休閒**：理大的體育設施包括多用途體育館、游泳池、健身中心及戶外球場。校園鄰近香港體育館及海濱長廊，適合休閒活動。
**生活與餐飲**：校園內有多個食堂及咖啡店，提供價格實惠的餐飲。非本地學生可申請學生宿舍，一年級申請者獲優先考慮。附近的紅磡及尖沙咀地區提供豐富的餐飲及購物選擇。

competitiveness.title: 競爭力與入學數據
content: **2025年中位數分數**：JS3004的HKDSE中位數分數為184.0，顯示競爭激烈。此分數採用「最佳5科」計算公式，並加入科目權重。
**2025年下四分位數**：下四分位數分數為181.0，即25%的獲取錄學生分數在此水平或以下。分數接近此水平的申請者應考慮將此課程列為「組別A」或「組別B」選擇。
**2025年平均分數**：加權後的HKDSE平均分數為188.8，反映課程的高學術標準。此平均分顯著高於理大許多其他課程的最低入學要求。
**科目權重**：核心科目（英文、中文、數學、通識教育）權重為1.0，而科學選修科（物理、化學、生物、延伸數學M1/M2）權重為1.5。其他選修科權重為1.0。第6科可獲5%的加分。
**申請貼士**：為最大化分數，應專注於科學選修科（物理、化學或M1/M2）取得佳績，因它們享有較高權重。建議取得184分或以上以具競爭力，190分以上則更為穩妥。

alumni.title: 知名校友
content: **陳國華工程師**：香港房屋署總工程師。畢業於理大土木工程學士課程，曾監督超過10,000個公營房屋單位的建造。
**李靜博士**：港鐵公司環境可持續發展總監。於理大取得環境工程博士學位，領導港鐵減碳計劃，自2015年實現排放量減少30%。
**黃志強先生**：金門建築有限公司董事總經理。理大建築工程及管理學畢業生，曾管理港珠澳大橋及西九文化區等地標項目。
**張雅詩女士**：奧雅納香港高級工料測量師。理大測量學士畢業，參與沙中線及啟德發展等大型基建項目。
**李彼得博士**：綠科工程有限公司創辦人及行政總裁。持有理大環境工程博士學位，其公司因創新廢物轉能技術屢獲獎項。
**陳明教授**：香港大學工程學院院長。於理大完成土木工程學士學位，後於麻省理工學院取得博士學位，現為香港工程師學會院士。

scholarships.title: 獎學金與資助
content: **理大入學獎學金**：頒予HKDSE成績優異的JUPAS申請者。JS3004學生若加權分數達190分或以上，可獲最高50,000港元獎學金；頂尖考生（200分以上）可獲全額學費資助（每年42,100港元）。
**建設及環境學院獎學金**：學院提供多項獎學金，包括「建設及環境學院傑出學生獎學金」（20,000港元）及「建設及環境學院行業夥伴獎學金」（15,000港元），頒予學術表現優異及積極參與行業活動的學生。
**政府獎學金**：合資格學生可申請香港特別行政區政府獎學金（每年40,000港元）及外展體驗獎（10,000港元）用於海外交流。政府亦透過學生資助處提供經入息審查的資助及貸款。
**行業贊助獎項**：金門建築、寶嘉建築及奧雅納等大型建築公司為JS3004學生提供獎學金及獎項，包括「金門建築獎學金」（30,000港元）及「奧雅納工程卓越獎」（20,000港元）。
**工作綜合教育（WIE）津貼**：參與WIE實習的學生每月可獲主辦機構發放8,000至12,000港元的津貼，有助減輕生活開支，同時獲得寶貴工作經驗。
**非本地學生資助**：非本地學生可申請理大非本地學生獎學金（最高全額學費）及香港博士研究生獎學金計劃。大學亦提供每年最高50,000港元的需要為本助學金。

tips.title: Ace Sir JS3004 攻略 — 9 個實用貼士
content: **1. 優先選擇科學選修科以獲取更高權重**
- 科學選修科（物理、化學、生物、M1/M2）權重為1.5，其他科目為1.0。物理科取得5級（加權7.5分）比經濟科5級（加權5分）更有價值。
- 建議至少修讀兩科科學選修科以最大化加權分數。若修讀三科，最佳兩科將計入前五名。
**2. 目標加權分數達190分以上**
- 中位數分數為184分，但平均分為188.8分。目標190分以上以成為具競爭力的申請者。這大致相當於三科5級及兩科4級（含科學權重）。
**3. 在英文及數學科表現出色**
- 英文及數學是核心科目，權重為1.0，但對滿足大學入學要求至關重要。英文科4級通常是專業認證的最低要求。
- 數學（必修部分）對工程專業尤為重要。目標取得5級或以上以增強申請競爭力。
**4. 策略性運用第6科加分**
- 第6科加分為最佳5科總分增加5%。若第6科成績優異（例如選修科5級），可顯著提升總分。
- 示例：最佳5科加權分數為180分，加上第6科加分（180的5% = 9分）= 189分，可能超越中位數。
**5. 提早研究心儀專業**
- JS3004是基礎廣泛的課程。申請前研究四個專業（建築工程、土木工程、環境工程、土地測量）。第一年成績及偏好將決定專業分配。
- 瀏覽理大網站獲取詳細專業介紹，並在開放日與在讀學生交流。
**6. 獲取相關工作經驗**
- 理大重視工作綜合教育（WIE）。申請前爭取暑期實習或兼職工作，例如建築、工程或環境顧問公司。這有助強化個人陳述及面試表現。
- 即使只是跟隨專業人士工作一週，也能展示你的投入。
**7. 為面試做好準備（如獲篩選）**
- JS3004內部分專業可能需要面試。準備常見問題，例如「為何選擇建設及環境？」及「你的職業目標是什麼？」。
- 攜帶相關項目作品集，例如科學展覽作品或設計作品。
**8. 提早申請並使用JUPAS組別A**
- 將JS3004放在組別A（第1至3志願）以最大化機會。此課程競爭激烈，組別A申請者獲優先考慮。
- 若預測分數接近邊緣（約181分），建議將其列為第1或第2志願。
**9. 探索理大的支援服務**
- 理大提供免費HKDSE溫習工作坊、學術諮詢及職業輔導。參加每年11月舉行的「JUPAS策略講座」。
- 使用理大網站上的「入學分數計算器」估算加權分數，並與過往入學數據比較。

curriculum.title: Curriculum Structure
content: **Programme Overview**: JS3005 is a broad-based engineering scheme under the Faculty of Engineering, allowing students to explore multiple disciplines before specialising. The programme adopts a flexible credit-based system with a total of 124 credits required for graduation.

**Year 1 — Foundation Year**: Students take common core courses in mathematics, physics, programming, and engineering fundamentals. This year is designed to build a strong technical base and help students identify their interests through introductory modules across civil, mechanical, electrical, and computing engineering.

**Year 2 — Broadening & Specialisation Selection**: Students continue with intermediate engineering subjects and select a major from 12+ options, including Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronic & Information Engineering, and Logistics & Enterprise Engineering. The selection is based on academic performance and personal preference.

**Year 3 — Deepening Specialisation**: Students focus on their chosen discipline with advanced core and elective courses. Work-Integrated Education (WIE) placements typically occur in the summer or during this year, providing at least 1 semester of real-world industry experience.

**Year 4 — Capstone & Professional Development**: Students undertake a final-year capstone project, often in collaboration with industry partners. Professional ethics, project management, and innovation modules complete the curriculum, preparing graduates for engineering chartership and postgraduate study.

**Work-Integrated Education (WIE)**: A hallmark of PolyU engineering, WIE requires students to complete a minimum of 100 hours of practical work experience. Many students secure placements at leading firms such as MTR Corporation, CLP Power, and Arup.

career.title: Career Prospects
content: **Graduate Employment Rate**: Over 90% of PolyU engineering graduates find employment within 6 months of graduation, with many receiving multiple job offers from top employers in Hong Kong and the Greater Bay Area.

**Diverse Industries**: Graduates of JS3005 are equipped for roles in construction, transportation, energy, manufacturing, information technology, and logistics. Common employers include the Hong Kong Government, MTR Corporation, CLP Power, Hongkong Electric, and global engineering consultancies.

**Professional Accreditation**: The programme is accredited by the Hong Kong Institution of Engineers (HKIE) and other international bodies, enabling graduates to pursue chartered engineer status after completing relevant work experience and professional assessments.

**Starting Salaries**: Fresh engineering graduates from PolyU typically earn between HKD 18,000 and HKD 25,000 per month, with specialisations like electrical and mechanical engineering commanding higher starting packages.

**Career Progression**: With 3–5 years of experience, many graduates advance to senior engineer, project manager, or technical lead roles. The Faculty of Engineering's strong industry connections facilitate rapid career growth.

**Entrepreneurship & Innovation**: PolyU's entrepreneurship support ecosystem, including the PolyU Micro Fund and the Innovation and Technology Scholarship, encourages engineering graduates to launch their own tech startups.

campus.title: Campus Life & Facilities
content: **Prime Location**: PolyU is located in Hung Hom, Kowloon, just a 5-minute walk from Hung Hom MTR station (East Rail Line and West Rail Line). The campus is also accessible via the Cross-Harbour Tunnel, making it convenient for students from all districts.

**State-of-the-Art Labs**: The Faculty of Engineering houses over 30 specialised laboratories, including the Industrial Centre, which features advanced manufacturing equipment, robotics labs, and a wind tunnel facility for civil and mechanical engineering research.

**Student Accommodation**: PolyU offers on-campus halls for undergraduate students, with priority given to non-local and first-year students. The halls are located within walking distance of the main campus and provide a vibrant residential community.

**Sports & Recreation**: The campus includes a multi-purpose sports complex with a swimming pool, gymnasium, basketball courts, and a running track. Students can join over 100 clubs and societies, including the Engineering Students' Society.

**Library & Learning Commons**: The Pao Yue-kong Library provides extensive engineering databases, 24/7 study spaces, and group project rooms. The Learning Commons on the ground floor is a popular collaborative study area.

**Greater Bay Area Connections**: PolyU's proximity to Shenzhen and the Greater Bay Area enables students to participate in cross-border internships, exchange programmes, and industry visits, enhancing their regional career prospects.

competitiveness.title: Competitiveness & Admission
content: **Overall Level**: Moderate to High (★★★☆☆)

**Admission Score Formula**: The programme calculates scores based on Chinese Language + English Language + Any Best 3 Subjects. This formula favours students with strong language skills and a balanced profile across elective subjects.
**Average Weighted Score**: The average HKDSE score with subject weighting for 2025 is 221.9. This places JS3005 in a moderately competitive range among PolyU engineering programmes.

**Subject Weighting**: While all subjects are considered, Mathematics and M1/M2 carry higher weighting in the 'Any Best 3' category. Students with strong STEM backgrounds have an advantage in the selection process.

**Interview Requirement**: Shortlisted candidates may be invited for an interview, which assesses motivation, problem-solving ability, and communication skills. The interview typically lasts 15–20 minutes and may include group discussion elements.

**Flexible Specialisation**: The broad-based structure reduces the risk of choosing the wrong major early. Students can switch between engineering disciplines up to the end of Year 2, making the programme attractive to those exploring options.

alumni.title: Notable Alumni & Achievements
content: **Dr. Ir. Albert Chan (陳帆)**: Former Secretary for Transport and Housing, Hong Kong SAR Government. Graduated with a degree in Civil Engineering from PolyU.
**Ir. Dr. the Hon. Lo Wai-kwok (盧偉國)**: Legislative Council Member (Engineering Functional Constituency) and Chairman of the Hong Kong Institution of Engineers. PolyU engineering alumnus.
**Dr. Ir. Peter Lee (李德明)**: CEO of MTR Corporation (2019–2023). Holds a Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering from PolyU and has led major infrastructure projects.
**Ir. Dr. Thomas Tang (鄧振強)**: Deputy Director of the Hong Kong Observatory. Graduated from PolyU's Department of Electrical Engineering and has contributed to meteorological advancements.
**Ir. Dr. Eric Ma (馬振峰)**: Founder and CEO of EGL Holdings, a leading engineering consultancy in Hong Kong. PolyU mechanical engineering graduate and recipient of the PolyU Outstanding Alumni Award.
**Ir. Dr. Joseph Lee (李志強)**: Managing Director of Arup East Asia. PolyU civil engineering alumnus who has overseen iconic projects such as the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge.

scholarships.title: Scholarships & Financial Support
content: **PolyU Entrance Scholarship**: Awarded to HKDSE top scorers with exceptional results (e.g., 5** in multiple subjects). The scholarship covers full tuition fees and provides a living allowance of up to HKD 50,000 per year.

**Faculty of Engineering Scholarships**: The Faculty offers multiple merit-based scholarships for engineering students, including the 'Engineering Dean's List Scholarship' (HKD 10,000–20,000) for top-performing students each semester.

**Work-Integrated Education (WIE) Subsidy**: Students undertaking unpaid internships or WIE placements may receive a subsidy of up to HKD 8,000 to cover travel and living expenses, ensuring equal access to practical experience.

**Government Financial Assistance**: Eligible students can apply for the HKSAR Government's Grant and Loan Schemes, including the Tertiary Student Finance Scheme (TSFS) and the Non-means-tested Loan Scheme (NLS).

**External Scholarships**: PolyU engineering students frequently win prestigious external awards such as the 'Hong Kong Institution of Engineers Scholarship' and the 'Innovation and Technology Scholarship' (up to HKD 150,000).
**Alumni Bursaries**: The PolyU Alumni Association provides need-based bursaries ranging from HKD 5,000 to HKD 20,000 for engineering students facing financial difficulties.

tips.title: Ace Sir's JS3005 Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: **1. Prioritise Language Scores**
- The admission formula counts Chinese + English + any best 3 subjects. Aim for Level 4 or above in both languages to maximise your score.
- A strong English score (Level 5 or 5*) can significantly boost your weighted total beyond the 221.9 average.
**2. Excel in Mathematics and M1/M2**
- Mathematics and M1/M2 carry higher weighting in the 'Any Best 3' category. Target Level 5 or above in these subjects.
- If you take M1 or M2, treat it as a core subject — it demonstrates quantitative ability valued by engineering departments.
**3. Build a Balanced Elective Profile**
- Choose electives that complement engineering: Physics, Chemistry, ICT, or Design & Applied Technology are strong choices.
- Avoid taking too many humanities electives unless you are confident they will be in your best 3 subjects.
**4. Prepare for the Interview**
- If shortlisted, expect questions like 'Why engineering?' and 'Which specialisation interests you?' Prepare specific examples from your school projects or competitions.
- Practice group discussion skills — the interview may include a case study or problem-solving task with other candidates.
**5. Explore Specialisations Early**
- Use Year 1 to attend departmental talks and lab tours. PolyU offers over 12 engineering majors — don't wait until Year 2 to decide.
- Talk to current students in different disciplines via the Engineering Students' Society or open days.
**6. Leverage Work-Integrated Education (WIE)**
- Start applying for summer internships in Year 1. Companies like MTR, CLP, and Arup recruit PolyU students early.
- The WIE requirement (100 hours minimum) can be completed through part-time jobs, internships, or research assistant roles.
**7. Use the Broad-Based Structure to Your Advantage**
- If you are unsure about your major, JS3005 is ideal — you can switch specialisations up to the end of Year 2 without penalty.
- Maintain a high GPA in Year 1 to keep all specialisation options open.
**8. Apply for Scholarships Proactively**
- The PolyU Entrance Scholarship requires separate application — submit your HKDSE results and a personal statement by the deadline (usually August).
- Even if you miss the entrance scholarship, apply for Faculty scholarships in Year 1 — many are based on first-semester grades.
**9. Connect with Alumni and Industry**
- Attend PolyU's Engineering Career Fair (held annually in September) to network with employers like AECOM, Gammon, and the Hong Kong Government.
- Join the PolyU Engineering Alumni Association LinkedIn group to seek mentorship and internship referrals.

curriculum.title: 課程結構
content: **課程概覽**：JS3005 是工程學院下設的基礎廣泛的工程學科組合課程，讓學生在專修前探索多個工程領域。課程採用靈活的學分制，畢業要求總共 124 學分。
**第一年 — 基礎年**：學生修讀數學、物理、編程及工程基礎等共同核心科目。這一年旨在建立堅實的技術基礎，並通過土木、機械、電機及計算機工程的入門單元幫助學生發掘興趣。
**第二年 — 拓寬視野與選擇專修**：學生繼續修讀中級工程科目，並從 12 個以上選項中選擇主修，包括土木工程、機械工程、電機工程、電子及資訊工程、物流及企業工程等。選擇基於學業成績和個人偏好。
**第三年 — 深化專修**：學生專注於所選學科，修讀高級核心及選修課程。工作綜合教育（WIE）實習通常在夏季或本年內進行，提供至少一個學期的真實行業經驗。
**第四年 — 頂石課程與專業發展**：學生完成畢業頂石項目，通常與行業夥伴合作。專業倫理、項目管理及創新模塊完成課程，為畢業生考取工程師資格及深造做好準備。
**工作綜合教育（WIE）**：作為理大工程學院的標誌，WIE 要求學生完成至少 100 小時的實際工作經驗。許多學生在港鐵公司、中電及奧雅納等領先企業獲得實習機會。

career.title: 就業前景
content: **畢業生就業率**：超過 90% 的理大工程畢業生在畢業後 6 個月內找到工作，許多人獲得香港及大灣區頂尖僱主的多份錄取通知。
**多元化行業**：JS3005 畢業生勝任建築、交通、能源、製造、資訊科技及物流等領域的職位。常見僱主包括香港政府、港鐵公司、中電、港燈及全球工程顧問公司。
**專業認證**：課程獲香港工程師學會（HKIE）及其他國際機構認可，畢業生完成相關工作經驗及專業評核後可考取特許工程師資格。
**起薪點**：理大工程畢業生月薪通常介乎港幣 18,000 至 25,000 元，電機及機械工程等專修起薪更高。
**職業晉升**：擁有 3 至 5 年經驗後，許多畢業生晉升為高級工程師、項目經理或技術主管。工程學院強大的行業聯繫促進快速職業發展。
**創業與創新**：理大的創業支援體系，包括理大微型基金及創新科技獎學金，鼓勵工程畢業生創辦自己的科技初創企業。

campus.title: 校園生活與設施
content: **優越地理位置**：理大位於九龍紅磡，步行 5 分鐘即達紅磡港鐵站（東鐵線及西鐵線）。校園亦可經海底隧道到達，方便來自各區的學生。
**先進實驗室**：工程學院設有超過 30 個專業實驗室，包括工業中心，配備先進製造設備、機械人實驗室及用於土木及機械工程研究的風洞設施。
**學生住宿**：理大為本科生提供校內宿舍，優先分配給非本地及一年級學生。宿舍位於主校園步行範圍內，提供充滿活力的住宿社區。
**體育與康樂**：校園設有多用途體育綜合大樓，包括游泳池、健身室、籃球場及跑道。學生可加入超過 100 個學會及社團，包括工程學會。
**圖書館及學習共享空間**：包玉剛圖書館提供豐富的工程數據庫、24 小時學習空間及小組研討室。地下學習共享空間是受歡迎的協作學習區域。
**大灣區聯繫**：理大毗鄰深圳及大灣區，學生可參與跨境實習、交流計劃及行業考察，提升區域就業前景。

competitiveness.title: 競爭力與入學要求
content: **入學分數計算公式**：課程按中國語文 + 英國語文 + 任何最佳 3 科計算分數。此公式有利於語文能力強且選修科目均衡的學生。
**平均加權分數**：2025 年經科目加權後的 HKDSE 平均分數為 221.9。這使 JS3005 在理大工程課程中處於中等競爭水平。
**科目比重**：雖然所有科目均獲考慮，但數學及 M1/M2 在「任何最佳 3 科」中佔較高比重。STEM 背景強的學生在遴選中具優勢。
**面試要求**：獲篩選的申請人或獲邀參加面試，評估動機、解難能力及溝通技巧。面試通常歷時 15 至 20 分鐘，可能包括小組討論環節。
**靈活專修**：基礎廣泛的結構降低了過早選錯主修的風險。學生可在第二年結束前轉換工程學科，使課程對探索選項的學生極具吸引力。

alumni.title: 知名校友及成就
content: **陳帆博士工程師**：前香港特別行政區運輸及房屋局局長。畢業於理大土木工程學系。
**盧偉國博士工程師**：立法會議員（工程界功能界別）及香港工程師學會前會長。理大工程學院校友。
**李德明博士工程師**：港鐵公司行政總裁（2019–2023）。持有理大土木工程學士學位，曾領導多項大型基建項目。
**鄧振強博士工程師**：香港天文台副台長。畢業於理大電機工程學系，對氣象學發展有貢獻。
**馬振峰博士工程師**：香港領先工程顧問公司 EGL Holdings 創辦人及行政總裁。理大機械工程畢業生，獲理大傑出校友獎。
**李志強博士工程師**：奧雅納東亞區董事總經理。理大土木工程校友，曾監督港珠澳大橋等標誌性項目。

scholarships.title: 獎學金與財務支援
content: **理大入學獎學金**：頒予 HKDSE 成績優異的頂尖考生（如多科 5**）。獎學金涵蓋全額學費並提供每年高達港幣 50,000 元的生活津貼。
**工程學院獎學金**：學院為工程學生提供多項基於成績的獎學金，包括每學期頒予頂尖學生的「工程學院院長榮譽榜獎學金」（港幣 10,000 至 20,000 元）。
**工作綜合教育（WIE）津貼**：進行無薪實習或 WIE 實習的學生可獲最高港幣 8,000 元的津貼，以支付交通及生活開支，確保平等獲得實踐經驗。
**政府資助**：合資格學生可申請香港政府的資助及貸款計劃，包括專上學生資助計劃（TSFS）及免入息審查貸款計劃（NLS）。
**外部獎學金**：理大工程學生經常獲得著名外部獎項，如「香港工程師學會獎學金」及「創新科技獎學金」（最高港幣 150,000 元）。
**校友助學金**：理大校友會為面對經濟困難的工程學生提供需要為本的助學金，金額介乎港幣 5,000 至 20,000 元。

tips.title: Ace Sir JS3005 攻略 — 9 個實用貼士
content: **1. 優先提升語文成績**
- 入學公式計算中文 + 英文 + 任何最佳 3 科。目標在兩科取得第 4 級或以上以最大化分數。
- 英文成績優異（第 5 級或 5*）可顯著提升加權總分，超越 221.9 的平均水平。
**2. 在數學及 M1/M2 表現出色**
- 數學及 M1/M2 在「任何最佳 3 科」中佔較高比重。目標在這些科目取得第 5 級或以上。
- 如果你修讀 M1 或 M2，將其視為核心科目——這展示工程學系重視的量化能力。
**3. 建立均衡的選修科目組合**
- 選擇與工程互補的選修科：物理、化學、資訊及通訊科技或設計與應用科技均為強勢選擇。
- 除非你確信人文學科能進入最佳 3 科，否則避免修讀過多文科選修。
**4. 為面試做好準備**
- 如獲篩選，預計會被問到「為何選擇工程？」及「哪個專修令你感興趣？」等問題。準備學校項目或比賽的具體例子。
- 練習小組討論技巧——面試可能包括與其他考生一起進行的個案研究或解難任務。
**5. 及早探索專修方向**
- 利用第一年參加學系講座及實驗室導賞。理大提供超過 12 個工程主修——不要等到第二年才決定。
- 透過工程學會或開放日與不同學科的現屆學生交流。
**6. 善用工作綜合教育（WIE）**
- 從第一年開始申請暑期實習。港鐵、中電及奧雅納等公司會較早招募理大學生。
- WIE 要求（最少 100 小時）可通過兼職工作、實習或研究助理角色完成。
**7. 利用基礎廣泛的結構**
- 如果你對主修不確定，JS3005 是理想選擇——你可以在第二年結束前轉換專修而無需受罰。
- 在第一年保持高 GPA，以保留所有專修選項。
**8. 主動申請獎學金**
- 理大入學獎學金需獨立申請——在截止日期（通常為 8 月）前提交 HKDSE 成績及個人陳述。
- 即使錯過入學獎學金，也可在第一年申請學院獎學金——許多基於第一學期成績。
**9. 與校友及業界建立聯繫**
- 參加理大工程就業博覽會（每年 9 月舉行），與艾奕康、金門建築及香港政府等僱主建立網絡。
- 加入理大工程校友會 LinkedIn 群組，尋求導師指導及實習推薦。

nameEn: Bachelor's Degree Scheme in Computer and Mathematical Sciences
nameZh: 計算機及數學科學組合學士課程

curriculum.title: Curriculum Structure
content: **Programme Overview**: JS3006 is a broad-based Bachelor's Degree Scheme in Computer and Mathematical Sciences, offering students a solid foundation in both computing and mathematics before specialising in their chosen area.
**Two Streams**: Students can choose between the Computer Science stream and the Data Science and Analytics stream, with the flexibility to decide after Year 1 based on interest and performance.

**Year 1**: Foundational courses include Calculus, Linear Algebra, Programming Fundamentals, Discrete Mathematics, and Introduction to Data Science, building essential quantitative and computational skills.
**Year 2**: Core subjects deepen knowledge in Algorithms, Probability and Statistics, Object-Oriented Programming, Database Systems, and Numerical Methods, with elective options emerging.
**Year 3**: Advanced specialisation courses such as Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Optimisation, and Big Data Analytics, plus a compulsory Work-Integrated Education (WIE) placement.
**Year 4**: Final-year capstone project and advanced electives, allowing students to apply their learning to real-world problems under faculty supervision.

career.title: Career Prospects
content: **Data Scientist**: Graduates are well-prepared for roles in data analytics, machine learning, and statistical modelling across finance, healthcare, and tech sectors.
**Software Engineer**: The strong programming and algorithmic foundation opens doors to software development, system design, and app development careers.
**Quantitative Analyst**: With deep mathematical training, graduates excel in quantitative finance, risk management, and algorithmic trading at banks and hedge funds.
**IT Consultant**: The combination of computing and mathematical skills is highly valued by consulting firms for technology strategy and digital transformation projects.
**Research & Academia**: Top-performing students can pursue postgraduate studies (MPhil/PhD) at PolyU or other leading universities worldwide.
**Government & Public Sector**: Opportunities exist in the Hong Kong government's IT departments, the Census and Statistics Department, and the Hong Kong Monetary Authority.

campus.title: Campus Life & Facilities
content: **Prime Location**: PolyU is located in Hung Hom, Kowloon, with direct MTR access via the Hung Hom station, connecting students to all parts of Hong Kong within minutes.
**State-of-the-Art Labs**: The Faculty of Science provides dedicated computer labs, high-performance computing clusters, and data analytics software for hands-on learning.
**Library & Learning Commons**: The Pao Yue-kong Library offers extensive digital resources, study spaces, and 24/7 access during exam periods.
**Student Organisations**: The Computer and Mathematical Sciences Society organises hackathons, coding competitions, and networking events throughout the year.
**Sports & Recreation**: PolyU's sports complex includes a swimming pool, gymnasium, and multi-purpose courts, promoting a healthy work-life balance.
**Greater Bay Area Connections**: The campus serves as a hub for internships and exchange programmes with leading tech companies in Shenzhen and Guangzhou.

competitiveness.title: Competitiveness & Admission Data
content: **Overall Level**: High (★★★★☆)
**Median Score (2025)**: The median HKDSE score with subject weighting was 215.0, indicating strong demand for this programme.
**Lower Quartile (2025)**: The lower quartile stood at 210.0, meaning even the bottom 25% of admitted students achieved high scores.
**Average Score**: The average HKDSE score with subject weighting was 220.4, reflecting the programme's competitive nature.
**Admission Formula**: PolyU uses the 'Any Best 5 Subjects' formula, allowing applicants to maximise their strengths across five subjects.
**Subject Weighting**: Core subjects (English, Mathematics) and electives like M1/M2, Physics, and ICT receive higher weighting, rewarding strong quantitative skills.

alumni.title: Notable Alumni & Success Stories
content: **Dr. Wong Kwok-yin (黃國恩博士)**: Renowned data scientist and former Head of Data Analytics at the Hong Kong Observatory, known for applying AI to weather prediction.
**Ms. Chan Mei-ling (陳美玲女士)**: Chief Technology Officer at a leading fintech firm in Hong Kong, specialising in blockchain and secure payment systems.
**Mr. Lee Ka-ho (李嘉豪先生)**: Co-founder of a successful AI startup in the Greater Bay Area, developing computer vision solutions for manufacturing quality control.
**Prof. Cheung Wai-shing (張偉成教授)**: Professor of Computer Science at a top UK university, recognised for research in algorithms and computational complexity.
**Mr. Ng Tsz-fung (伍梓豐先生)**: Senior Software Engineer at Google, working on cloud infrastructure and distributed systems since graduating in 2018.
**Dr. Lam Hoi-yan (林海欣博士)**: Research Scientist at the Hong Kong Applied Science and Technology Research Institute (ASTRI), focusing on natural language processing.

scholarships.title: Scholarships & Financial Support
content: **PolyU Entrance Scholarship**: Awarded to students with outstanding HKDSE results (e.g., score above 230), covering full or partial tuition fees for the first year.
**Faculty of Science Merit Scholarship**: Recognises top-performing students in the programme, with awards up to HK$20,000 per year based on academic achievement.
**HKSAR Government Scholarship**: Available to local students with exceptional academic records and leadership potential, valued at HK$40,000 annually.
**Work-Integrated Education (WIE) Allowance**: Students on compulsory WIE placements may receive a stipend from partner companies, reducing financial burden.
**Exchange Programme Bursaries**: Financial support for students participating in overseas exchange programmes, covering travel and living expenses.
**Need-Based Financial Aid**: PolyU offers grants and low-interest loans through the Student Financial Assistance Agency (SFAA) for eligible students.

tips.title: Ace Sir's JS3006 Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: **1. Prioritise Core Subjects**: Focus on English, Mathematics Compulsory, and M1/M2 — these carry higher weighting in the admission score formula. Aim for Level 5 or above in each.
- English and Mathematics are double-weighted in many cases, so a Level 5 in these subjects can significantly boost your total score.
- If you take M1 or M2, aim for at least Level 4, as it demonstrates quantitative readiness for the programme.
**2. Leverage 'Any Best 5' Flexibility**: Use the admission formula to your advantage by dropping your weakest subject. If you have 6 subjects, the best 5 will be counted.
- Identify your top 5 subjects early and allocate study time accordingly. For example, if you are strong in Physics and ICT, invest extra effort there.
- Avoid spreading yourself too thin — quality over quantity in your best 5 subjects.
**3. Build a Strong Mathematics Profile**: The programme values mathematical maturity. Take M1 or M2 if possible, and aim for Level 5 or above.
- Join mathematics competitions (e.g., HKMO, AMC) to strengthen your problem-solving skills and demonstrate passion.
- Practice past HKDSE mathematics papers under timed conditions to improve speed and accuracy.
**4. Excel in Electives with Weighting**: Subjects like Physics, Chemistry, ICT, and Economics are often weighted higher. Target Level 5 in at least two of these.
- For ICT, focus on programming and database concepts, as they directly relate to the programme content.
- For Physics, emphasise mechanics and electromagnetism, which build logical thinking.
**5. Prepare for Interviews (If Shortlisted)**: Some applicants may be invited for an interview. Show genuine interest in computing and mathematics through examples.
- Prepare a 1-minute self-introduction highlighting your passion for coding or data analysis.
- Be ready to discuss a recent project or competition you participated in, such as a hackathon or math Olympiad.
**6. Gain Practical Experience Early**: Participate in coding bootcamps, online courses (e.g., Coursera, edX), or open-source projects to build a portfolio.
- Complete a beginner Python or R course before applying — this shows initiative and readiness.
- Contribute to a GitHub project or build a simple app to demonstrate hands-on skills.
**7. Research the Two Streams**: Understand the difference between Computer Science and Data Science & Analytics. Choose based on your career goals.
- Computer Science is ideal if you enjoy algorithms, software engineering, and system design.
- Data Science & Analytics suits those interested in statistics, machine learning, and big data.
**8. Aim for a Score Above 215**: With a median of 215.0 and average of 220.4, target at least 215 to be competitive. A score of 220+ puts you in a strong position.
- Use the PolyU online admission calculator to estimate your weighted score based on predicted grades.
- If your predicted score is below 210, consider retaking subjects or improving through supplementary exams.
**9. Plan for WIE and Exchange**: The Work-Integrated Education component is compulsory. Start researching partner companies (e.g., Google, HSBC, HKSTP) early.
- Attend PolyU's career fairs and WIE briefing sessions in Year 1 to secure a placement by Year 3.
- Consider a semester exchange to universities in the US, UK, or Singapore to broaden your global perspective.

curriculum.title: 課程結構
content: **課程概覽**：JS3006 是一個基礎廣泛的計算機及數學科學組合學士課程，為學生在計算機和數學領域打下堅實基礎，然後選擇專修方向。

campus.title: 校園生活與設施
content: **優越地理位置**：理工大學位於九龍紅磡，經紅磡站直達港鐵，數分鐘內連接香港各區。
**先進實驗室**：理學院提供專用電腦實驗室、高性能計算集群和數據分析軟件，支援實踐學習。
**圖書館與學習共享空間**：包玉剛圖書館提供豐富的電子資源、學習空間，並在考試期間提供24小時開放。
**學生組織**：計算機及數學科學學會全年舉辦黑客松、編程比賽和聯誼活動。
**體育與康樂**：理工大學體育綜合大樓設有游泳池、健身室和多用途場地，促進健康生活平衡。
**大灣區聯繫**：校園是與深圳和廣州頂尖科技公司實習和交流計劃的樞紐。

competitiveness.title: 競爭力與入學數據
content: **2025年中位分數**：經科目加權後的中位HKDSE分數為215.0分，顯示該課程需求強勁。
**2025年下四分位數**：下四分位數為210.0分，意味著即使最低的25%錄取學生也取得了高分。
**平均分數**：經科目加權後的平均HKDSE分數為220.4分，反映課程的競爭性。
**入學計分公式**：理工大學採用「最佳5科」計分方式，讓申請人最大化五科的優勢。
**科目加權**：核心科目（英文、數學）及選修科如M1/M2、物理和資訊及通訊科技獲得較高加權，獎勵強大的量化能力。

alumni.title: 知名校友與成功故事
content: **黃國恩博士**：著名數據科學家，曾任香港天文台數據分析主管，以應用人工智能於天氣預測聞名。

**李嘉豪先生**：大灣區一家成功人工智能初創公司的聯合創始人，開發用於製造業質量控制的計算機視覺解決方案。

scholarships.title: 獎學金與財務支援
content: **理工大學入學獎學金**：頒發給HKDSE成績優異的學生（例如分數高於230分），涵蓋第一年全額或部分學費。
**理學院優秀生獎學金**：表彰課程中表現頂尖的學生，每年最高可達20,000港元，基於學術成就。
**香港特區政府獎學金**：提供給學術成績卓越且具領導潛力的本地學生，每年價值40,000港元。
**校企協作教育（WIE）津貼**：參與強制性WIE實習的學生可從合作公司獲得津貼，減輕經濟負擔。
**交流計劃助學金**：為參加海外交流計劃的學生提供財務支援，涵蓋旅行和生活費用。
**按需財務援助**：理工大學透過學生資助處（SFAA）為合資格學生提供助學金和低息貸款。

tips.title: Ace Sir JS3006 攻略 — 9 個實用貼士
content: **1. 優先處理核心科目**：專注於英文、數學必修和M1/M2——這些在入學計分公式中權重較高。目標是每科達到5級或以上。
- 英文和數學在許多情況下獲得雙倍權重，因此這兩科取得5級可顯著提升總分。
- 如果你選修M1或M2，目標至少達到4級，以展示你對量化學習的準備。
**2. 善用「最佳5科」的靈活性**：利用入學計分公式，放棄你最弱的科目。如果你有6科，只計算最好的5科。
- 及早識別你的最佳5科，並相應分配學習時間。例如，如果你擅長物理和資訊及通訊科技，就在這些科目上投入更多精力。
- 避免過度分散——在最佳5科中追求質量而非數量。
**3. 建立強大的數學背景**：該課程重視數學成熟度。如有可能，選修M1或M2，並目標達到5級或以上。
- 參加數學競賽（例如香港數學競賽、美國數學競賽）以強化解題能力並展示熱情。
- 在計時條件下練習過往HKDSE數學試卷，以提高速度和準確性。
**4. 在加權選修科中表現出色**：物理、化學、資訊及通訊科技和經濟等科目通常獲得較高加權。目標在至少兩科中達到5級。
- 對於資訊及通訊科技，專注於程式設計和數據庫概念，因為它們與課程內容直接相關。
- 對於物理，強調力學和電磁學，這些能培養邏輯思維。
**5. 為面試做好準備（如獲篩選）**：部分申請人可能獲邀面試。通過實例展示你對計算機和數學的興趣。
- 準備1分鐘的自我介紹，突出你對編程或數據分析的熱情。
- 準備討論你最近參與的項目或比賽，例如黑客松或數學奧林匹克。
**6. 及早獲得實踐經驗**：參加編程訓練營、在線課程（例如Coursera、edX）或開源項目，建立個人作品集。
- 在申請前完成基礎Python或R課程——這顯示你的主動性和準備程度。
- 貢獻於GitHub項目或建立一個簡單的應用程式，展示實踐技能。
**7. 研究兩個專修方向**：了解計算機科學與數據科學與分析之間的區別。根據你的職業目標選擇。
- 如果你喜歡算法、軟件工程和系統設計，計算機科學是理想選擇。
- 如果你對統計學、機器學習和大數據感興趣，數據科學與分析更適合。
**8. 目標分數高於215分**：由於中位數為215.0分，平均分為220.4分，目標至少215分以保持競爭力。220分以上會讓你處於強勢位置。
- 使用理工大學在線入學計算器，根據預測成績估算你的加權分數。
- 如果你的預測分數低於210分，考慮重考科目或通過補考提升成績。
**9. 提前規劃WIE和交流**：校企協作教育（WIE）是必修部分。及早研究合作公司（例如Google、滙豐、香港科技園）。
- 在第一年參加理工大學的就業博覽會和WIE簡介會，確保在第三年獲得實習機會。
- 考慮到美國、英國或新加坡的大學進行一學期交流，擴闊你的全球視野。

nameEn: Bachelor's Degree Scheme in Humanities
nameZh: 人文學科組合學士課程

curriculum.title: Curriculum Structure
content: **Programme Overview**: JS3007 is a broad-based Bachelor's Degree Scheme in Humanities, offering students flexibility to explore multiple disciplines before specialising. The programme is designed with a strong emphasis on critical thinking, cultural literacy, and applied humanities skills.

**Two Streams**: Students can choose from two main streams — Chinese History and Culture, or English and Applied Linguistics — with the option to customise their own interdisciplinary pathway through elective courses.

**Year 1**: Foundation year covering core humanities subjects such as Introduction to Humanities, Academic Writing, and Critical Thinking. Students take 6-8 compulsory courses to build a solid academic base.
**Year 2**: Specialisation begins with stream-specific core courses (e.g., Chinese Historical Sources, Phonetics and Phonology). Students also select 2-3 electives from other humanities disciplines.

**Year 3**: Advanced coursework and research methods training. Students undertake a capstone project or dissertation (6 credits) and participate in Work-Integrated Education (WIE) for at least 1 semester.

**Year 4**: Final year focuses on advanced seminars, independent research, and career preparation. Students complete a final-year project and may opt for an additional WIE placement or exchange programme.

career.title: Career Prospects
content: **Broad Career Pathways**: Graduates are well-prepared for roles in education, media, cultural management, public relations, government, and non-profit sectors. The programme's flexibility allows students to pivot across industries.

**Education Sector**: Many graduates become secondary school teachers (Chinese or English), curriculum developers, or educational consultants. PolyU's strong teaching placement network supports this path.

**Media and Communications**: Roles include journalist, editor, content strategist, and digital marketing specialist. Alumni have joined leading media houses like TVB, South China Morning Post, and RTHK.
**Cultural and Heritage Management**: Graduates work in museums, art galleries, heritage sites, and cultural festivals. Hong Kong's West Kowloon Cultural District is a key employer.

**Government and Public Service**: Positions in the Hong Kong Civil Service (e.g., Administrative Officer, Executive Officer) and statutory bodies are common, leveraging humanities graduates' analytical and communication skills.

**Further Study**: Approximately 30% of graduates pursue postgraduate degrees (MA, MPhil, PhD) at top universities in Hong Kong, UK, US, and Australia, including University of Hong Kong, University of Cambridge, and University of Sydney.

campus.title: Campus Life & Facilities
content: **Prime Location**: PolyU's main campus is in Hung Hom, Kowloon, directly connected to Hung Hom MTR station (East Rail Line and West Rail Line). The campus is a 10-minute walk from Tsim Sha Tsui East.

**Humanities Hub**: The Faculty of Humanities is housed in the iconic Jockey Club Tower, featuring state-of-the-art language labs, multimedia studios, and a dedicated humanities library with over 100,000 volumes.

**Student Facilities**: Students enjoy access to the PolyU Sports Centre (indoor swimming pool, gym, climbing wall), the Innovation Tower, and 24/7 study spaces. The campus has over 50 student clubs and societies.

**Work-Integrated Education (WIE)**: All humanities students complete at least 1 WIE placement (typically 6-12 weeks). Recent placements include the Hong Kong Palace Museum, Cathay Pacific, and the Hong Kong Arts Festival.

**Global Exchange**: PolyU has exchange agreements with over 200 universities worldwide. Humanities students can spend one semester abroad at partner institutions such as University of California, Berkeley, University of Manchester, and Peking University.
**Living Support**: On-campus housing is guaranteed for first-year students (subject to application). The campus also offers a medical clinic, counselling services, and career advising centre.

competitiveness.title: Competitiveness & Entry Requirements
content: **Overall Level**: High (★★★★☆)
**Admission Score Formula**: Any Best 5 Subjects — the programme considers the best 5 HKDSE subject results, giving students flexibility to leverage their strongest subjects.

**Subject Weighting**: Core subjects (Chinese, English, Mathematics) are weighted at 1.0x, while elective subjects in humanities (e.g., Chinese History, English Literature, History) are weighted at 1.5x. Other electives are weighted at 1.0x.
**Average Score (2025)**: The average HKDSE score with subject weighting is 185.5. This is a competitive benchmark for applicants targeting this programme.

**Interview Requirement**: Shortlisted applicants may be invited for an interview, which assesses motivation, communication skills, and subject interest. The interview can contribute up to 10% of the overall admission score.

**Application Tips**: Strong performance in Chinese and English is essential. Applicants with elective subjects in humanities or social sciences have a distinct advantage due to higher weighting. A personal statement highlighting interest in humanities is highly recommended.

alumni.title: Notable Alumni
content: **Dr. Chan Kwok-bun (陳國彬教授)**: Renowned sociologist and author, former Head of Department of Sociology at Hong Kong Baptist University. Graduated from PolyU's humanities programme in the 1980s.
**Ms. Wong Yuen-ling (黃婉玲)**: Senior Curator, Hong Kong Palace Museum. Oversees exhibitions on Chinese art and culture. Graduated in 2005 with a degree in Chinese History and Culture.
**Mr. Leung Chi-wai (梁志偉)**: Award-winning journalist and editor, South China Morning Post. Specialises in cultural reporting and feature writing. Graduated in 2010.
**Dr. Li Sze-ming (李思明博士)**: Assistant Professor of English Linguistics, University of Hong Kong. Published over 30 research papers on applied linguistics. Graduated in 2012.
**Ms. Cheng Hoi-yan (鄭海欣)**: Founder and CEO, Cultural Connect Limited, a social enterprise promoting heritage education in Hong Kong. Graduated in 2015.
**Mr. Ng Ka-ho (吳嘉豪)**: Administrative Officer, Hong Kong Government. Currently serving in the Home Affairs Bureau. Graduated in 2018.

scholarships.title: Scholarships & Financial Aid
content: **PolyU Humanities Entrance Scholarship**: Awarded to top HKDSE applicants with a weighted score of 190 or above. Covers full tuition fees for the first year (up to HK$42,100).
**Faculty of Humanities Merit Scholarship**: Available to current students with a GPA of 3.5 or above. Provides HK$20,000 per year for up to 2 years.
**Dr. Li Ka-shing Scholarship**: For students demonstrating outstanding academic achievement and financial need. Covers full tuition and living expenses (up to HK$120,000 per year).
**Work-Integrated Education Bursary**: Supports students undertaking unpaid WIE placements. Provides up to HK$10,000 per placement.
**Exchange Scholarship**: Students participating in overseas exchange programmes can apply for funding of up to HK$30,000 to cover travel and accommodation costs.

**Government Financial Assistance**: Eligible students can apply for the HKSAR Government's Grant and Loan Schemes, including the Tertiary Student Finance Scheme (TSFS) and Non-means-tested Loan Scheme (NLS).

tips.title: Ace Sir's JS3007 Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: **1. Prioritise Humanities Electives**
- Choose HKDSE electives like Chinese History, English Literature, or History — these are weighted at 1.5x, giving you a significant score boost.
- Aim for Level 5 or above in these subjects to maximise your weighted score.
**2. Master Core Subjects**
- Chinese and English are weighted at 1.0x but are essential for the interview and future studies. Target Level 5 or above in both.
- Practice essay writing and critical analysis — these skills are tested in the admission interview.
**3. Calculate Your Weighted Score Early**
- Use the formula: (Chinese + English + Math) × 1.0 + (Best 2 humanities electives) × 1.5 + (Other best subject) × 1.0.
- The average weighted score is 185.5 — aim for at least 190 to be competitive.
**4. Prepare a Strong Personal Statement**
- Write a 500-word statement explaining your passion for humanities. Mention specific books, films, or cultural events that inspired you.
- Highlight any relevant extracurriculars (e.g., debate club, writing competitions, museum visits).
**5. Ace the Interview**
- The interview contributes up to 10% of your score. Prepare to discuss current affairs in Hong Kong and global cultural trends.
- Practice answering questions in both English and Cantonese — the interview may be bilingual.
**6. Leverage Work-Integrated Education**
- Research WIE placements early. Popular options include the Hong Kong Palace Museum, M+, and the Hong Kong Arts Festival.
- A strong WIE experience can boost your CV and help you secure a job after graduation.
**7. Explore Exchange Opportunities**
- PolyU has exchange partners like UC Berkeley and Peking University. Plan your exchange in Year 2 or 3 to broaden your horizons.
- Apply for the Exchange Scholarship (up to HK$30,000) to reduce costs.
**8. Build a Portfolio**
- Keep a portfolio of your best essays, research projects, and creative work. This is useful for job applications and further study.
- Participate in the Faculty's annual Humanities Symposium to showcase your work.
**9. Network with Alumni**
- Connect with PolyU humanities alumni on LinkedIn. They can offer mentorship and internship opportunities.
- Attend faculty career talks and alumni events — these are held at least twice per semester.

curriculum.title: 課程結構
content: **課程概覽**：JS3007 是一個基礎廣泛的人文學科組合學士課程，讓學生在專修前探索多個學科。課程強調批判性思維、文化素養及應用人文技能。
**兩個專修**：學生可選擇兩個主要專修——中國歷史與文化，或英語及應用語言學——並可透過選修科目自訂跨學科路徑。
**第一年**：基礎年，涵蓋人文學科核心科目，如人文學導論、學術寫作及批判性思維。學生需修讀6-8個必修科目以建立堅實的學術基礎。
**第二年**：開始專修，修讀專修核心科目（如中國歷史文獻、語音學與音系學）。學生亦可從其他人文學科中選擇2-3個選修科。
**第三年**：高級課程及研究方法訓練。學生需完成一個頂石項目或論文（6學分），並參與至少一個學期的「工作整合教育」（WIE）。
**第四年**：最後一年專注於高級研討班、獨立研究及職業準備。學生完成畢業項目，並可選擇額外的WIE實習或交流計劃。

career.title: 就業前景
content: **廣泛職業路徑**：畢業生勝任教育、媒體、文化管理、公共關係、政府及非牟利機構等領域。課程靈活性讓學生可在不同行業間轉型。
**教育領域**：許多畢業生成為中學教師（中文或英文）、課程發展人員或教育顧問。理大強大的教學實習網絡支持此路徑。
**媒體與傳播**：職位包括記者、編輯、內容策略師及數碼營銷專員。校友已加入TVB、南華早報及香港電台等主要媒體機構。
**文化與遺產管理**：畢業生在博物館、畫廊、遺產地及文化節工作。香港西九文化區是主要僱主。
**政府與公共服務**：香港政府（如政務主任、行政主任）及法定機構的職位常見，利用人文學科畢業生的分析及溝通能力。
**深造**：約30%畢業生在香港、英國、美國及澳洲頂尖大學攻讀研究生課程（文學碩士、哲學碩士、博士），包括香港大學、劍橋大學及悉尼大學。

campus.title: 校園生活與設施
content: **優越位置**：理大主校園位於九龍紅磡，直接連接紅磡港鐵站（東鐵線及西鐵線）。校園距離尖沙咀東僅10分鐘步行路程。
**人文學科樞紐**：人文學院設於標誌性的賽馬會大樓，配備先進語言實驗室、多媒體工作室及專門人文圖書館，藏書超過10萬冊。
**學生設施**：學生可使用理大體育中心（室內游泳池、健身室、攀石牆）、創新樓及24小時學習空間。校園有超過50個學生社團。
**工作整合教育（WIE）**：所有人文學科學生需完成至少1次WIE實習（通常6-12週）。近期實習包括香港故宮文化博物館、國泰航空及香港藝術節。
**環球交流**：理大與全球超過200所大學有交流協議。人文學院學生可到加州大學柏克萊分校、曼徹斯特大學及北京大學等夥伴院校交流一個學期。
**生活支援**：一年級學生可保證入住校內宿舍（需申請）。校園亦設有醫療診所、輔導服務及就業輔導中心。

competitiveness.title: 競爭力與入學要求
content: **入學分數公式**：最佳5科——課程考慮HKDSE最佳5科成績，讓學生靈活運用最強科目。
**科目加權**：核心科目（中文、英文、數學）加權為1.0倍，人文學科選修科（如中國歷史、英國文學、歷史）加權為1.5倍。其他選修科加權為1.0倍。
**平均分數（2025年）**：經科目加權後的HKDSE平均分為185.5分。這是申請者競爭的重要基準。
**面試要求**：入圍申請者或獲邀面試，評估動機、溝通能力及學科興趣。面試可佔總入學分數最多10%。
**申請貼士**：中文及英文成績至關重要。選修人文學科或社會科學的申請者因較高加權而具明顯優勢。強烈建議提交個人陳述以突出人文學科興趣。

alumni.title: 知名校友
content: **陳國彬教授（Dr. Chan Kwok-bun）**：著名社會學家及作家，曾任香港浸會大學社會學系系主任。1980年代畢業於理大人文學科課程。
**黃婉玲女士（Ms. Wong Yuen-ling）**：香港故宮文化博物館高級策展人，負責中國藝術與文化展覽。2005年畢業於中國歷史與文化專修。
**梁志偉先生（Mr. Leung Chi-wai）**：獲獎記者及編輯，任職南華早報，專注文化報導及專題寫作。2010年畢業。
**李思明博士（Dr. Li Sze-ming）**：香港大學英語語言學助理教授，發表超過30篇應用語言學研究論文。2012年畢業。
**鄭海欣女士（Ms. Cheng Hoi-yan）**：文化連線有限公司創辦人及行政總裁，該社會企業推廣香港遺產教育。2015年畢業。
**吳嘉豪先生（Mr. Ng Ka-ho）**：香港政府政務主任，現任職於民政事務局。2018年畢業。

scholarships.title: 獎學金與經濟援助
content: **理大人文學科入學獎學金**：頒予加權分數達190分或以上的頂尖HKDSE申請者，涵蓋第一年全額學費（最高HK$42,100）。
**人文學院優秀學生獎學金**：提供予GPA達3.5或以上的在讀學生，每年HK$20,000，最多兩年。
**李嘉誠博士獎學金**：給予學術成績優異及有經濟需要的學生，涵蓋全額學費及生活費（每年最高HK$120,000）。
**工作整合教育助學金**：支援參與無薪WIE實習的學生，每次實習最高HK$10,000。
**交流獎學金**：參與海外交流計劃的學生可申請最高HK$30,000資助，用於旅費及住宿。
**政府經濟援助**：合資格學生可申請香港政府資助及貸款計劃，包括「專上學生資助計劃」（TSFS）及「免入息審查貸款計劃」（NLS）。

tips.title: Ace Sir JS3007 攻略 — 9 個實用貼士
content: **1. 優先選擇人文學科選修科**
- 選擇中國歷史、英國文學或歷史等HKDSE選修科——這些科目加權為1.5倍，可顯著提升分數。
- 目標在這些科目取得5級或以上，以最大化加權分數。
**2. 精通核心科目**
- 中文及英文加權為1.0倍，但對面試及未來學習至關重要。目標在兩科取得5級或以上。
- 練習論文寫作及批判分析——這些技能在入學面試中會測試。
**3. 及早計算加權分數**
- 使用公式：（中文 + 英文 + 數學）× 1.0 + （最佳2個人文學科選修科）× 1.5 + （其他最佳科目）× 1.0。
- 平均加權分數為185.5分——目標至少190分以具競爭力。
**4. 準備強而有力的個人陳述**
- 撰寫500字陳述，解釋你對人文學科的熱情。提及啟發你的書籍、電影或文化活動。
- 突出相關課外活動（如辯論隊、寫作比賽、參觀博物館）。
**5. 在面試中脫穎而出**
- 面試佔總分最多10%。準備討論香港時事及全球文化趨勢。
- 練習以英語及粵語回答問題——面試可能以雙語進行。
**6. 善用工作整合教育**
- 及早研究WIE實習機會。熱門選擇包括香港故宮文化博物館、M+及香港藝術節。
- 良好的WIE經驗可提升履歷，幫助畢業後找到工作。
**7. 探索交流機會**
- 理大有加州大學柏克萊分校及北京大學等交流夥伴。計劃在第二年或第三年交流以擴闊視野。
- 申請交流獎學金（最高HK$30,000）以減輕開支。
**8. 建立作品集**
- 保存最佳論文、研究項目及創意作品的作品集。這對求職及深造有用。
- 參與學院年度人文學科研討會以展示你的作品。
**9. 與校友建立網絡**
- 在LinkedIn上與理大人文學科校友聯繫。他們可提供指導及實習機會。
- 參加學院職業講座及校友活動——這些活動每學期至少舉辦兩次。

nameEn: Bachelor's Degree Scheme in Science
nameZh: 理學組合學士課程

curriculum.title: Curriculum Structure
content: **Programme Overview**: JS3008 is a broad-based Bachelor's Degree Scheme in Science offered by PolyU's Faculty of Science. Students explore multiple science disciplines before choosing a major, with an average HKDSE admission score of 196.5 (with subject weighting).

**Year 1 Foundation**: All students take common core courses in mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, and scientific communication, building a strong interdisciplinary base. This year allows exploration of different science streams.

**Year 2 Major Selection**: Students choose from majors including Applied Physics, Chemistry, Data Science and Analytics, Environmental Science, and Food Safety and Technology. Each major has specific required and elective courses.

**Year 3 Specialisation**: In-depth study in the chosen major, with laboratory work, research projects, and industry-linked assignments. Students can also opt for a minor in another science discipline.

**Year 4 Capstone & WIE**: Final year includes a capstone research project or dissertation, plus a mandatory Work-Integrated Education (WIE) placement. This real-world experience is a hallmark of PolyU programmes.

**Flexible Pathways**: The scheme offers double major options and interdisciplinary projects, allowing students to tailor their degree to career goals. Exchange programmes with partner universities are also available.

career.title: Career Prospects
content: **High Employability**: PolyU science graduates have a strong employment rate, with many securing jobs within 6 months of graduation. The average starting salary for science graduates is around HKD 18,000–22,000 per month.

**Diverse Industries**: Graduates work in pharmaceuticals, environmental consulting, data analytics, food safety, education, and government laboratories. The Greater Bay Area offers additional opportunities.

**Research & Academia**: Top students can pursue MPhil/PhD at PolyU or overseas universities. The Faculty of Science has strong research groups in materials science, environmental monitoring, and bioinformatics.
